title_en: With Cards Now Selling for Up to $1,500, These Are the 10 Most Valuable One Piece TCG Cards You Can Still Pull From Booster Packs Right Now
summary_en: From $1,500 "Heroine Edition" cards to pricey Manga Rares, here are the 10 most valuable One Piece TCG pulls you can still land from sealed booster packs in 2026.
body_en:
Trading card games have seen massive growth in recent years, both in terms of the number of players and within the secondary market.
The One Piece TCG , which launched in the States in late 2022, is no exception.
And like every other TCG on the market, one of the most fun and rewarding activities, aside from actually playing the game, is ripping booster packs in search of your coveted chase cards.
One Piece singles are some of the most valuable of any TCG, often compared to the Pokémon collector market, with alternate cards fetching upwards of $1,300 or more.
And these don't include special exclusive promotional cards; these are just singles you can pull out of packs. So we've broken down some of the most valuable cards you can still pull out of sealed One Piece TCG boosters right now.
This is by no means an exhaustive list of valuable One Piece cards, as dozens of other pulls are worth hundreds of dollars, but it's a good starting point at least.
10. Roronoa Zoro SP - The Azure Sea's Seven
Roronoa Zora has seen a handful different printings since his time in the One Piece TCG, but this one of the best we've seen. Pick one up for about $760 if you're having hard luck pullikng one.
9. Uta Manga Rare - Extra Booster: One Piece Heroines Edition
Manga Rares are some of the most sought-after cards in the game (as you'll see further down the list), but Uta is one of the few not to break the $1,000 price tag.
8. Borsalino Manga Rare - The Time of Battle
Borsalino is the next most valuable One Piece card and Manga Rare, sitting at about $930 at the time of writing.
7. Enel Manga Rare - Adventure on Kami's Island
One of two Manga Rare's from the Adventures on Kami's Island expansion, Enel is currently hovering around $1,000.
This makes for a chase card for many players, since Enel is a metagame staple in the One Piece competitive scene.
6. Kuzan Manga Rare - The Time of Battle
Kuzan is the second of three Manga Rares from The Time of Battle, going for just over $1,000, and is joined by Borsalino and Sakazuki...
5. Sakazuki Manga Rare - The Time of Battle
...Who is currently going for $1200.
The three Manga Rares from The Time of Battle are the three Admirals from Marineford, making them pretty sought-after in the collector market.
4. Nami SP - Extra Booster: One Piece Heroines Edition
The Extra Booster: One Piece Heroines Edition set features popular female characters from throughout One Piece's long history.
Many of the SP cards, like Nami here, are both rare and competitively-viable, making it one of the more popular chase cards.
3. Boa Hancock SP - Extra Booster: One Piece Heroines Edition
Like Nami, Boa Hancock is a very popular and powerful card in the competitive environment.
But its One Piece Heroines Edition printing is going for around $1400 at the time of writing, so good on you if you were able to rip one.
2. Buggy (Gold) - The Azure Sea's Seven
The second most valuable One Piece card from boosters is the Gold version of Buggy.
The Silver is valuable as well, but this one takes the cake.
1. Nico Robin SP - Extra Booster: One Piece Heroes Edition
Also from the Extra Booster: One Piece Heroines Edition expansion, Nico Robin's SP printing is at just over $1,500 ungraded.
And like Nami and Boa Hancock, she's a playable staple in competitive decks and a popular character, which explains her premium price tag.
